captions.detailed: This object is a catadioptric mirror lens housed in a short, fat, dark-grey cylindrical casing. It features a central reflective mirror cell inside the front aperture and a smaller, off-center dark-grey knob on the rear face. The internal mirror cell translates along the optical axis via a prismatic joint to adjust focus, while the rear filter slot knob rotates continuously on a revolute joint.
captions.instruction: Create an articulated catadioptric mirror lens assembly in CadQuery. The assembly must feature a main cylindrical housing, an adjustable inner mirror cell that translates along the central axis via a prismatic joint, and a rear filter slot knob that rotates on a continuous revolute joint.
captions.factory: Construct the main housing by combining a hollow cylinder with a flat rear plate. Model the inner mirror cell as a concentric cylinder with a reflective front face, then define a prismatic joint along the Z-axis relative to the housing. Create the rear knob using a small cylinder offset from the center, and define a continuous revolute joint rotating around its local Z-axis.
